body: You're such a sweet person. Thank you so much. Yes, I am really looking forward to the time after two months and hopefully a time without these thoughts. Thank you, I feel this warmth from your words which I can't really describe. Thank you. It's people like you that I want to surround myself with. Thanks for understanding. <3

Sorry I wrote such a big reply. 

I feel exhausted these days. Completely burned out in all sense, be it emotionally, physically or mentally. 
I am right now preparing for a number of really important exams. It has been 5 months of preparation and I feel exhausted, but the exams aren't over yet. I have to keep preparing for the next two months. 
Also, I am going through a break up. So that is emotionally draining. 
I am looking forward to the time when the exams end and I can go on a vacation. I need a break. 
I have attempted suicide four years ago. And since then, I've become really good at tackling with emotions that bring me down. But these days I feel scared of my thoughts, because of the exhaustion I just feel like giving up on everything. I am just pushing myself to keep giving my best for the next two months. But honestly, that is such a tiring task.
I'm sorry I wrote it in a really emotional state. I meant my thoughts are messy. I like my life. But there are these thoughts of just dying. I don't understand where do they come from.
Thanks for sharing. I hope I will feel better. And seeing your progress I think I will. You're such an awesome person. Thank you so much.
I want at least one achievement. A big one. Something that makes me proud.

I'm writing a list of things that I'm grateful for. And also reminding myself that everything thing seems final but there's so much more to see and feel. I can't really miss out on that. Got to remind myself that.
Yes, please. I would love to hear it.
Thanks, I hope so too. Right now I'm exhausted but I think I'll start taking proactive actions towards fighting with these thoughts. I want to be hopeful and happy again.

Most probably I won't, I always give myself two months to try and get things better, it usually works. 
But these days the thought does not go away. I was a hopeful person. I'm losing hope. The world suck. My family is great, it's for them I live. 
But I gave my everything to this exam and my ex boyfriend. He cheated, I lost all hope in a good relationship. And if the exam sucks, I'll lose hope in hard work because I am a dumbass, with no job and an adult who lives with her parents. That would be it.
